_note: AI-drafted Call to Worship — pending Wilson's curation.

registers.label: Spare
lines: Christ is risen!
Christ is risen, Alleluia!
Two walked the road home at evening, talking of all they had lost.
A stranger fell in step and opened the Scriptures to them.
They knew him at last in the breaking of the bread,
and their hearts burned within them.
Stay with us, Lord; the day is far spent.
Christ is risen, Alleluia!

registers.label: Immersive
lines: Walk the road as the light goes long and gold, the dust of a hard week still on your feet.
Christ is risen, Alleluia!
A stranger falls in step beside you and begins to speak, and something in you starts to warm.
Christ is risen, Alleluia!
At the table he takes the bread, blesses, breaks it — and your eyes fly open, and you know him.
Christ is risen, Alleluia!
On the holy mountain a feast is spread, the shroud over the nations torn away, every tear wiped dry.
Christ is risen, Alleluia!
So come to the table where he is known, and tell what you saw on the road:
Christ is risen, Alleluia!

registers.label: Hybrid
lines: The day grows late; we walk the road home.
Christ is risen, Alleluia!
A stranger opens the Scriptures, and our hearts catch fire.
Christ is risen, Alleluia!
He breaks the bread, and we know him.
Christ is risen, Alleluia!
Stay with us, Lord, and we will worship.
Christ is risen, Alleluia!
